chunks: It is narrated that he said
in expressing this meaning as well: The question (or matter) is the tent of flaws, and he who is pleased with himself attracts many who are displeased with him.

key_terms.الْمَسْأَلَةُ: The matter/question (referring to the issue of reconciliation or covering faults)

ai.seo_question: What is the relationship between self-satisfaction and public criticism according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: In this wisdom, Imam Ali employs the metaphor of a 'tent' (khiyab) to illustrate how mutual forbearance conceals human flaws, preserving social harmony and dignity. This concept is deeply rooted in the Shia emphasis on *sitr* (covering faults) as a virtue that prevents the escalation of criticism, contrasting sharply with the arrogance of self-satisfaction which invites public scrutiny and displeasure.
